notes.summary: Handwritten continuation numbered 68: a Boolean-algebra conjecture qualified by a long oblique note, supports described through clopen parts of a spectrum, involution/complementation, and a cosupport definition from the ordered set and compatibility relation. The lower example identifies connected components as supports and cites C4. The page has no abstract diagram; it has four insertion leaders/carets and the long lower rule.
notes.math_reading_decisions: Recognizing the proposed distributive pattern prompted symbol-by-symbol attention to the three wedges, two vees, P,Q,R, and extra edge marks, but did not determine their readings. The last set was read item by item, including all primes, comma, quantifier and braces. No theorem was proved or disproved and no outside-page mathematical facts were used to repair the text. Consistent x/X differences and M/R alphabet choices are not counted as mathematical changes merely because their appearance differs.
notes.author_checks: The author writes “Je [dis struck] présume” and, in the oblique note, “je ne vois comment prouver” without a visible pas. The struck “Il faudra y revenir” is retained. These are statements on the manuscript, not reader validation events.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Visible manuscript page number 68 at top centre; scan marker 69 retained. No date, title sheet, cote marker, archive page number or independent heading is added.
notes.h_editorial_note: H acknowledges the long marginal note only in an editorial note with fragments and P,Q,R; those fragments are not treated as a complete diplomatic transcription. Its prose assertion identifying R was not used as evidence. H’s description of a lower separating rule is noted but does not substitute for reproducing the drawing.
notes.inspection_limitations: Crop 07 clips some upper-right surrounding context; the full je/prouver groups are available in crops 06/08. The main targets are not decided from a clipped boundary. The slanted crop fields necessarily overlap neighboring upright body writing. No whole or half image was redisplayed, no decided locus was recropped, and all 11 crop images were viewed once.
notes.structural_checks: JSON parsed successfully. LaTeX braces balanced after excluding escaped literal braces and comments; 3 tikzpicture environments and 1 scope balanced; 30 dollar delimiters and both display pairs balanced; all 11 crop paths exist; all 41 difference rows and 27 C-doubt/context rows have explicit named-image bboxes. No compiler was used.
